verdict.rationale: Airbyte's connector catalog and standardized sync engine (typing-deduping, one-to-one table mapping) let the same pipeline write to hundreds of destinations including major warehouses, lakes, and databases without pipeline rewrites (airbyte-gh-1, airbyte-docs-32, airbyte-docs-24/41, airbyte-docs-51). Missing for 10: explicit named coverage of Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks/Postgres/object-storage as destinations in evidence, and independent hands-on proof that swapping destinations requires no pipeline changes.
